# supervisor: every combination of listing (from the last complete inventory) and shim files, its state; then each against every observation: the new facts, the new state and the signal.
# Every combination is reachable: the listing and the shim are observed independently, in any order, also across a restart.
unlisted_yet/never_started => unobserved
unlisted_yet/alive => running
unlisted_yet/exited => stopped
unlisted_yet/lost => process_lost
absent/never_started => absent
absent/alive => absent
absent/exited => absent
absent/lost => absent
stopped/never_started => present
stopped/alive => running
stopped/exited => stopped
stopped/lost => process_lost
running/never_started => process_lost
running/alive => running
running/exited => process_lost
running/lost => process_lost
unlisted_yet/never_started x Inventory(Absent) -> absent/never_started absent None
unlisted_yet/never_started x Inventory(Stopped) -> stopped/never_started present None
unlisted_yet/never_started x Inventory(Running) -> running/never_started process_lost Some(ProcessLost)
unlisted_yet/never_started x InventoryIncomplete -> unlisted_yet/never_started unobserved None
unlisted_yet/never_started x Shim(NeverStarted) -> unlisted_yet/never_started unobserved None
unlisted_yet/never_started x Shim(Alive) -> unlisted_yet/alive running None
unlisted_yet/never_started x Shim(Exited) -> unlisted_yet/exited stopped None
unlisted_yet/never_started x Shim(Lost) -> unlisted_yet/lost process_lost Some(ProcessLost)
unlisted_yet/alive x Inventory(Absent) -> absent/alive absent Some(Vanished)
unlisted_yet/alive x Inventory(Stopped) -> stopped/alive running None
unlisted_yet/alive x Inventory(Running) -> running/alive running None
unlisted_yet/alive x InventoryIncomplete -> unlisted_yet/alive running None
unlisted_yet/alive x Shim(NeverStarted) -> unlisted_yet/never_started unobserved None
unlisted_yet/alive x Shim(Alive) -> unlisted_yet/alive running None
unlisted_yet/alive x Shim(Exited) -> unlisted_yet/exited stopped Some(ObservedStopped)
unlisted_yet/alive x Shim(Lost) -> unlisted_yet/lost process_lost Some(ProcessLost)
unlisted_yet/exited x Inventory(Absent) -> absent/exited absent Some(Vanished)
unlisted_yet/exited x Inventory(Stopped) -> stopped/exited stopped None
unlisted_yet/exited x Inventory(Running) -> running/exited process_lost Some(ProcessLost)
unlisted_yet/exited x InventoryIncomplete -> unlisted_yet/exited stopped None
unlisted_yet/exited x Shim(NeverStarted) -> unlisted_yet/never_started unobserved None
unlisted_yet/exited x Shim(Alive) -> unlisted_yet/alive running None
unlisted_yet/exited x Shim(Exited) -> unlisted_yet/exited stopped None
unlisted_yet/exited x Shim(Lost) -> unlisted_yet/lost process_lost Some(ProcessLost)
